Commentary.Commentary: It is time for the chase to begin! Jonny Bairstow and Jason Roy are the openers. Chameera to begin with.

It is a target which should be easily chased by England. Also, one expects them to do so quite quickly. Anything other than a England win will be an upset. Is there one on the cards? We will find out.

The England bowling was excellent, their fielding was even better. Have to say it was a complete performance in the field by them, one their captain will be really pleased about. Everybody played their part but Rashid and Wood were the stars.

Another poor outing with the bat for Sri Lanka! They just never got going. They lost Gunathilaka early on and from there on, it just kept getting worse. They kept losing wickets at regular intervals and not only that, to add to that, runs scoring was also difficult, let alone the boundaries even rotation of strike was difficult. Just the two batters were able to hit boundaries, one of them was Mendis and the other was Udana. Speaks volumes about how poor they were.

In the air...Safe! A length ball, around middle and leg. Udana follows the line of the delivery and lifts the ball high in air towards the mid off region. Chris Jordan calls for it, as he runs towards the ball. But he is a bit late to get under it, as the ball lands in a vacant area just in front of him. The batters come back for the second. SRI LANKA END THEIR INNINGS AT 111 FOR 7.
Back of a length ball, around off, Udana looks to play the upper cut as he sways away from the line of the delivery.

SIX! Udana is doing everything he can to add some crucial runs on the board. Poor from Jordan. This is full and on off, Udana shuffles to the leg side and powers it over the long off fence for a maximum.
A length ball, on off, Udana pulls it to long on for a couple.
A length ball, on off, Udana pushes it to cover.
FOUR! The lankans would take a boundary however it comes. A full length ball, on off, Udana swings his blade and powers it over mid off. The ball ends up in the boundary with one bounce at long off.
A low full toss, this is hit down to long off for one.
A full ball on off, it is hit through covers for one.
A single as this is hit down to long off.
On the pads, Udana looks to heave it but misses.
A single as this is guided through point.
WIDE! Another wide! Down the leg side. Akila misses the flick.
WIDE! Way too short, Akila lets it go over him. Wided.
Just short! Outside off, Udana swings, it goes off the outer half but lands well short of deep point. One taken.
What a successful over for Chris Jordan. Just two runs and a wicket of the over. Fires in a yorker, outside off, Akila Dananjaya looks to chase it but misses.
Slower ball, on off, Akila Dananjaya defends it solidly.

OUT! CAUGHT! This is all going downhill for Sri Lanka. Dasun Shanaka was the last hope for the team, this is not a pretty sight for the away team. Jordon gets his first wicket of the game. Serves a full length ball, on off, Shanaka is tempted as it is in the slot. He gets under it and powers it towards long on. But he does not middle it and end up hitting it with the toe end of the bat. The ball does not get the distance as David Willey takes a simple catch at long on.
Commentary.Howout: c David Willey b Chris Jordan

Commentary.Commentary: BEATEN! A slower delivery, outside the off pole. Shanka looks to defend it but misses.
WIDE! A bouncer on middle, Shanaka leaves it alone. The ball goes over the head of the batsman. Wide given.
A length ball, on off, Udana drives it to the left of mid off. Where Mark Wood moves to his left to make a half stop. The batter scamper for a single.
Good length ball, on off, Udana looks to pull it but misses.
Loopy ball, on off, Udana pushes it to the off side for a single.
On off, pushed to cover.
Udana walks out to bat!

OUT! STUMPED! Wanindu Hasaranga had to take the risk but it doesn't pay off. His short innings comes to an end. The Lankan side is folding like a pack of cards here. A loopy ball, on off, Rashid takes a little bit of the pace off it. Hasaranga dances down the track and looks to heave it away. He misses the ball completely, as it ends up in Jonny Bairstow mitts behind the stumps, as he takes the bails off in a flash giving no time to Wanindu Hasaranga to turn and make his way back in the crease.
Commentary.Howout: st Jonny Bairstow b Adil Rashid

Commentary.Commentary: Tosses it up, on off, Dasun Shanaka works it towards mid on and takes off for a single.
Floated full and outside off, Hasaranga cuts it through point for a single.
Lands it fuller, on off, Shanaka flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, around middle and leg, Shanaka flicks it to the leg side and gets a single.
BEATEN! Just a bit of seam movement. A length ball, outside off, Shanaka looks to defend but misses as the ball zips past the outside edge to the keeper.
Back oa a length delivery, on the ribs, Hasaranga blocks it to the leg side for another single.
Good length ball, around middle, Shanaka nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, on off, Shanaka keeps it out.

Angles in a length ball, on the pads, Dasun Shanaka stays in the crease, hops and looks to flick it but misses. The ball goes onto hit the pads and rolls to the off side. A silent appeal by Jonny Bairstow, umpire is not interested.
Another single as this is worked through square leg.
Good running! On middle, this is worked with soft hands on the leg side. Two taken.
The sweep is out but it goes off the inner half towards short fine leg.
On middle, shortish, this is pulled through square leg for one.
This time he finds the gap by driving it through covers for one.
Tossed up on off, Shanaka pushes it towards cover. The fielder dives to his left and saves one.
BEATEN! Outside off and on a length. Hasaranga looks to push at it but misses.
Shorter and on off, Hasaranga guides it to point.
Almost the hat-trick! Full and outside off, just the line his skipper wanted him to bowl as he had two slips in place. Hasaranga looks to drive but is beaten.
Who will come out next? It is Wanindu Hasaranga to walk in at No. 7 to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust! Wood has two in two and it was a brilliant move to get him on. On off, Dickwella looks to play a lofted shot but it hits the upper part and it is an easy catch for Eoin Morgan at covers. Wood is on a hat-trick now.
Commentary.Howout: c Eoin Morgan b Mark Wood

Commentary.Commentary: The next batsman to walk in at No. 6 is Dasun Shanaka.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a very good catch! It went very high and Mendis, who was starting to get a move on, falls at the wrong time for Lanka! On middle, it is shortish. Mendis goes for the pull but he gets a top edge. It goes high up in the air towards square leg. Bairstow goes after it and takes it nicely.
Commentary.Howout: c Jonny Bairstow b Mark Wood

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Really good shot! Mendis makes room and moves towards the leg side. He is followed by Wood but it is a full ball. He lifts it over mid on for a boundary.
Mark Wood back into the attack from the River End. His figures 2-0-11-0 so far. Replaces Chris Jordan.
The sweep is out, it is hit through square leg for one more.
This is worked through mid-wicket for one.

Two! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket. They take one and go for the second. Billings gets to the ball quickly and fires it to the bowler who fails to collect the ball. Had he done so, Mendis was a goner.
The next batsman to walk in at No. 5 is Niroshan Dickwella.

OUT! TAKEN! Captain Perera is out of here! He looks to play the reverse sweep, it is the googly on off. Comes slow off the surface. Perera is early in the shot, it goes off the toe-end and it is an easy catch for Morgan. Lanka slip further just as the momentum looked like shifting.
Commentary.Howout: c Eoin Morgan b Adil Rashid

Commentary.Commentary: The slog sweep is out but not off the middle, it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for two.
PUT DOWN! This is short and on the body, Perera looks to pull but he gets a top edge. It goes towards fine leg. Malan runs to his right and then dives but spills it. Tough chance. Two taken.
Just the one! Once again moves inside the line and this is bowled on the body, it is helped on its way towards fine leg for one.
Another dot! Shorter and outside off, it skids through. Mendis looks to cut but is beaten.
SIX! Over the fence! That is a welcome biggie! It is short and on the body, Mendis helps it on its way and it goes over the fine leg fence. They need more of this.
A slower one outside off, Mendis looks to play the upper cut again but misses.
Well fielded! Shorter and on middle, this is whacked towards mid on. The fielder moves to his left, slides and keeps it down to one.
A couple to end the over! Loopy ball, on off, Mendis clips it through mid-wicket for two runs.
Floated on off, Perera pushes it to cover for a single.

Two more! Loopy ball, full and on off, Perera plays the reverse sweep. The ball takes the top edge and flies towards third man. The fielder cuts it out in time. The batters come back comfortably for the second run.
Flighted on off, Mendis clips it to square leg for another single.
Tossed up, on off, Perera gets low and sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for another single.
Loopy ball, on off, Mendis sweeps it to the leg side for a single.
Adil Rashid comes into the attack now.
Really good fielding and just the three runs from the over! Mendis moves right across and tries the paddle scoop. Fine leg is nice and fine so he stops it. Just one.
Another single! On the pads, Perera works it down to fine leg and gets to the other end.
One taken! Just the one run from the first 4 balls! On off, Mendis plays it late and down to third man for one.
Yet another dot! Wood is bowling with a lot of fire here! Length and on off, this one straightens. Mendis pokes at it but gets beaten.
Two dots in a row! Short and on middle, Mendis looks to go over the keeper with an upper cut but misses.
On off, Mendis looks to go over mid off but does not time it. A dot.
An appeal for a catch! Has that directly come off his foot? We will find out as it is taken upstairs.

NOT OUT! Floated, on off, Perera looks to defend it but gets an inside edge. But does the ball bounce off the pitch or off his toe to Jonny Bairstow. Liam Livingstone has his one arm in the air, as he makes an silent appeal for the catch. The umpires converge and take it upstairs. Soft signal is NOT OUT. A single replay confirms that the ball bounces on the deck. The decision stands.
Tossed up, on off, Mendis works it to the leg side for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Mendis late cuts it away from third man for a couple.
On off, kept out.
FOUR! Up and Over! What a shot! Floated around off, Mendis dances down the track and lifts it over the cover region for a boundary.
Loopy ball, on off, Mendis clips it to mid-wicket.
On a length, outside off, Mendis cuts it to third man for a single. A great over for the Islanders.
BEATEN! A nice comeback by Mark Wood. A good length ball, around off, Mendis is forced to stay back, and he misses his defence. The ball beats the outside edge.
FOUR! This time he finds the boundary. Good length ball, outside off, Mendis waits and cuts it through third man for a boundary.
A length ball, on the pads, Perera works it to square leg for a single.

This is fullish and outside off, Mendis swings his blade wildly, as he goes to go big. The ball takes the outside and goes towards third man. But cannot find the boundary, as the fielder cuts it off in time. Just a single.
A length ball, around middle, Perera clips it to square leg for a single.
A dot to end the over! Floated on off, Mendis works it towards mid on.
Floated on off, Mendis pushes it to mid off.
Flatter, outside off, Perera stays back and cuts it through point for another single.
Floated, around middle, Medis nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, on off, Mendis goes back and defends it back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, on off, Perera pushes it to cover and scamper for a single.
Livingstone is on!
Back of a length ball, on off, Mendis looks to pull this away but misses.
A length ball, on off, Perera flicks it to the leg side for a single.

A length ball, on off, Perera lofts it over the mid off fielder, as it lands safely in a vacant region and races towards the boundary at long off. David Willey makes a brilliant diving stop and save two.
A full length ball, on off, Mendis flicks it through mid-wicket for another single.
A length ball, on the pads, Perera goes back and tucks it to square leg for a single.
Starts his spell with a good length ball, outside off, Kusal Perera looks to pull this away but misses. The ball goes through to the keeper.
Chris Jordan comes into the attack from the other end.
Another dot! Another one on middle, Mendis pushes it to mid on. Sri Lanka going nowhere at the moment.
One more dot! On middle, this is worked to mid on.
BEATEN! Outside off, Mendis has a poke at it but it goes past the outside edge.
This time he finds the gap! Fuller and on off, this is driven through covers for two.
Yet another dot! On off, it is pushed to mid off.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Hits the splice of the bat! Length and on off, Perera plays it to point. Another good over for England. They are well and truly on top.
Attacks the stumps again, this is pushed to mid on.
Mendis is off the mark as he works this on the leg side.
Kusal Mendis walks in at No. 4.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust and Curran has a wicket now! Sri Lanka in big trouble! This is short and on middle, Fernando looks to pull. He needed to get all of it as it is the bigger side of the ground. Does not time it well and Liam takes a good catch at deep square leg.
Commentary.Howout: c Liam Livingstone b Sam Curran

Commentary.Commentary: Two more! On middle, Fernando pulls it towards short fine leg. The fielder there dives to his left and gets a hand to it. Two more. England have fielded really well so far.
That is hit really hard! On middle, it is pulled through square leg for one.

NOT OUT! It is clipping the top of leg which means it is umpire's call!  Not a bad idea to review though! On middle and coming back in. Perera looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the off side. A single is taken as the appeal is turned down. England review but replays show that the on-field call stays.
Eoin Morgan takes a review for LBW. The Original decision was NOT OUT. The Ultra Edge confirms no bat involved. The Ball Tracker confirms umpires call for hitting the wickets. As the decision stands.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Perera looks to flick but misses.
On off, kept out.
A single as this is pushed towards cover.
Good stop! Fuller and on off, this is driven towards mid off. Jordan there dives to his left and saves two for his side.
On off, Fernando pushes it to covers.
Around off, this is guided wide of point for one.
A single to end another good over by England! On middle, this is pulled towards mid on for one.
Two! Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for two.
On middle, kept out.
The next man to come out in the middle is Kusal Perera.

OUT! RUN OUT! That is the worst possible start for the visitors! There was never a run there. Gunathilaka was well short. On middle, Fernando looks to flick but he gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the wicket. They go for a run. Curran gets to the ball and kicks it onto the stumps at the keeper's end. The dive does not save the left-hander. England players are delighted.
BEATEN AGAIN! Fernando for a second time has been beaten by this kind of a delivery. It lands on off and then shapes away. Fernando looks to defend but is beaten.
Beautiful shot for one! Fuller and on off, no swing for Curran too. This is pushed to mid off for one.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is going to be Sam Curran.
A single to end a tidy first over by Willey! On middle, this is worked towards mid on for one.
Fernando is off the mark now! On middle, this is worked towards square leg for one.
Excellent delivery! Lands this on off and then gets it to shape away! Fernando is beaten as he looks to put bat on ball.
Slightly fuller and just outside off, this one too does not swing. Fernando wants a sighter so he lets it go to the keeper.
Gunathilaka is underway now! Back of a length this time and on middle, this is worked around the corner for one.

Lanka are underway! This one is on the pads, Willey is looking to shape it away but it does not move. Danushka looks to flick but this goes off the pads down towards fine leg. The fielder at short fine leg hares after it and keeps it down to two. Good fielding.

The match begins! The England players are making their way out in the middle, as they take their respective positions. Danushka Gunathilaka and Avishka Fernando follow, as they come out to bat. David Willey to start with tha ball.

England (PLAYING XI) - Jason Roy, Jonny Bairstow (WK), Dawid Malan, Eoin Morgan (C), Sam Billings (IN PLACE OF JOS BUTTLER), Liam Livingstone, Sam Curran, David Willey (IN PLACE OF CHRIS WOAKES), Chris Jordan, Adil Rashid, Mark Wood.

Sri Lanka (PLAYING XI) - Danushka Gunathilaka, Avishka Fernando, Kusal Perera (C), Kusal Mendis, Niroshan Dickwella (WK) (IN PLACE OF DHANANJAYA DE SILVA), Dasun Shanaka, Wanindu Hasaranga, Isuru Udana, Akila Dananjaya, Dushmantha Chameera, Binura Fernando (IN PLACE OF NUWAN PRADEEP).
TOSS - The coin goes up and falls in the favour of Sri Lanka. They opt to bat first.

Hello and welcome to the second T20I game between England and Sri Lanka. As expected, the first T20I was quite one-sided in favor of the hosts and the second is expected to be no different. Another good show from the hosts will see them seal the series. Lanka on the other hand, have to win it if they are to stay alive. Will we see a closer contest between bat and ball this time? We will have to wait and find out. Stayed tuned for more updates!
